items.title: 由开辛单值群与偶次张量欧拉乘积推出闭点 Frobenius 权重（Milne 30.6(a)）
items.author_responsibility: 保留 Milne 原讲义中 (a) 的题面、实际证明、具名先修及原印刷用语。此条收录范围为作者单列的权重结论。
items.difficulty_reason: Open monodromy gives Zariski density. The symplectic invariant forms computed by pairings determine all even tensor-power geometric coinvariants as sums of Q_l(−kn). The multiplicative trace formula then makes the denominator a power of 1−q^(kn+1)t. Coefficientwise domination by the global Euler product transfers the convergence radius to each local factor, and taking the 2kth root with k→∞ gives the upper weights; the pairing supplies reciprocal lower weights. The local Euler-radius argument and the invariant-theory determination of the global denominator are both supplied and jointly carry the purity claim.

target_scope.original_scope: For the original lisse Q_l sheaf on the Chapter II smooth affine curve, keep rationality of all closed-point Frobenius actions, the invariant nondegenerate alternating pairing into Q_l(−n), and open geometric symplectic monodromy. Select the conclusion that E has weight n. No semisimplicity and no P¹ embedding added.
target_scope.mature_inputs: The proof invokes the established multiplicative trace formula in the smooth curve case (29.6) and the classical symplectic invariant theorem (30.11 cites Weyl VI.1 or Fulton–Harris Appendix F) as named prerequisites. Their separate fixed-work proof dispositions remain. The selected purity proof supplies the arithmetic/geometric bridge; it does not replace those premises with a new proof.

fixed_errata.role: 30.2 的官方勘误限定一般逆命题，(a) 只使用两种原解读均提供的有理特征系数和幂次迹。

printed_details: The p179 second Euler-product display lacks exp and its trace sum writes t^m. The following p180 author proof explicitly displays log(1/det)=sum Tr(F_x^m) t^(m deg x)/m, and 30.9 starts again from the correct determinant product. The exact earlier display is retained; the subsequent original argument gives the operative formula.

30.8 calls its coefficients positive, but even powers can vanish and local factors can have missing degrees. The next original lemma 30.9 explicitly uses the nonnegative inequality a_(m,x)≥0, which follows from the printed trace-power argument. Preserve the source wording and count no separate strict 30.8 claim.

The erratum to 30.2 is relevant to the formulation of rationality. The proof of (a) uses rational characteristic coefficients and rational traces of powers, which follow under either printed condition. No proof of the false converse or new assumption is used.

The p180 pole exponent 2k/deg x is visibly a fraction. The next bound has a stray x subscript on the parenthesized q term; the displayed fraction inequality and following limiting exponent are present.
target_scope.same_proof_core: 30.8–30.11, including the conditional convergence-to-purity argument 30.9, are all part of the exact (a) proof chain. No second target selected from that same core.
target_scope.whole_30_6_disposition: 仅收录原标注结论 (a)。保留全题及 (b)/(c) 待补，精确依赖和印刷问题见 RESULT.json。
